user_visible_outcome: The existing private video can advance from Uploading to its real Cloudflare processing or ready state without another upload.
user_journeys: An authenticated Admin checks the status of the already attached private birth video.
non_negotiable_quality: Do not delete, replace, duplicate, publish, or re-upload the private video.
Do not modify any photograph record, caption, alt text, order, placement, or cover selection.
Keep operational diagnostics free of family content and provider identifiers.
realistic_harms_prevented: A valid Cloudflare duration is rejected by the integer database column and leaves the video permanently labelled Uploading.
Repair work accidentally alters approved family photographs or captions.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Finite non-negative Cloudflare durations are normalized to whole seconds before persistence; unavailable or invalid durations remain null.
A failed status update produces a safe server diagnostic and the existing truthful user message.
The production build reaches READY and the existing video status can be refreshed without re-upload or deletion.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: Vercel deployment status plus one owner Check status action.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The five-photo database fingerprint, cover selection, draft status, and attachment count remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.proof_command: Compare read-only Supabase fingerprints before and after the live status refresh.

non_goals: Change player UI, upload UX, video provider, authentication, image handling, Chapter prose, or publication state.
Add a migration, dependency, service, queue, retry loop, or automatic status polling.
simplest_acceptable_approach: Normalize Cloudflare's numeric duration at the provider boundary with Math.ceil, retain the existing integer schema, and add one safe diagnostic at the database update boundary.

complexity_exception.reason: The scope gate classifies any path containing cloudflare as infrastructure and a new-service change. This repair touches the existing provider adapter only; it creates no service, account, token, configuration, or infrastructure resource.
criteria: No provider configuration, credential, service, migration, or dependency change.
Only duration normalization at the existing Cloudflare response boundary is allowed.
